columns.name: briefing_date
columns.description: The date this briefing covers (one current row per user/day — enforced by write_briefing's RLS-scoped find-or-create, not a DB constraint, since `unique` is table-wide and would block every member but the first).

columns.name: content
columns.description: The generated briefing prose, rendered live in the app.

columns.name: generated_at
columns.description: When this briefing was generated — also the watermark the */5 refresh compares commitments against, so it only regenerates when something changed since.
